    Indecomposable projectives of a basic algebra #

    For Corollary 5.5 (mesh-deformations.tex) we identify a basic algebra A with the algebra A₀ of its projective labels. Here: the right ideal eA of a primitive idempotent is isomorphic to e_i A for one idempotent of a complete set (exists_iso_ideal: some e e_i e is a unit of the local corner eAe, so eA is a retract of e_i A), and for a basic algebra distinct e_i A are not isomorphic (eq_of_iso_ideal).
